source_text: Intel Foundry and ASML highlighted continued progress in bringing High NA EUV into volume production.
Samsung and ASML team up on next-generation semiconductor manufacturing technology.
TSMC intends to use High NA in high-volume manufacturing at advanced nodes from 2030.
ASML plans to transition to larger mask sizes, allowing High NA machines to produce data center chips.
Samsung plans to introduce ASML's High NA EUV lithography technology into high-volume manufacturing of DRAM by 2028.
Volume production on select layers for a subset of Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors, code-named Panther Lake.
The results were presented at the 2026 SPIE Photomask Technology + EUV Lithography Conference.
